tips.text: Hit the daily standing cap with normal play first, then turn in medallions, which bypass the cap.
Do the three daily Syndicate Alerts for each syndicate every day; their standing and medallions do not count against the cap.
Hit the cap fast in endless modes such as Circuit to stage 4 or Sanctuary Onslaught, with the syndicate sigil equipped.
Put a whole Exterminate to sleep with Equinox or Ivara and melee the sleepers to cap standing in a run or two.
Buy two Barrels and two Receivers; stopping at one of each is the most common mistake.
Rank the Archwing version to 30 in Archwing missions; the Atmosphere entry earns no separate Mastery.
Expect a few days of capped standing plus alert medallions; the standing is the only slow part.
